comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind.name: comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind
comment_threads_anchor_matches_kind.value:
("comment_threads"."anchor_kind" = 'storyboard_shot') = ("comment_threads"."anchor_shot_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("comment_threads"."anchor_kind" <> 'storyboard_shot') = ("comment_threads"."anchor_node_id" IS NOT NULL)

scenes_story_clock_needs_day.name: scenes_story_clock_needs_day
scenes_story_clock_needs_day.value: "scenes"."story_clock" IS NULL OR "scenes"."story_day" IS NOT NULL

credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind.name: credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind
credit_ledger_delta_matches_kind.value:
(
        ("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('reserve', 'spend', 'expire') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" < 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('grant', 'purchase', 'release', 'refund') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" > 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'adjust' AND "credit_ledger"."delta" <> 0)
      )

shots_lens_and_duration_sane.name: shots_lens_and_duration_sane
shots_lens_and_duration_sane.value: ("shots"."lens_mm" IS NULL OR "shots"."lens_mm" > 0) AND ("shots"."duration_seconds" IS NULL OR "shots"."duration_seconds" >= 0)

research_clip_filings_one_target.name: research_clip_filings_one_target
research_clip_filings_one_target.value:
("research_clip_filings"."kind" = 'character' AND "research_clip_filings"."character_id" IS NOT NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."location_id" IS NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."scene_node_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("research_clip_filings"."kind" = 'location' AND "research_clip_filings"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."character_id" IS NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."scene_node_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("research_clip_filings"."kind" = 'scene' AND "research_clip_filings"."scene_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."character_id" IS NULL AND "research_clip_filings"."location_id" IS NULL)
